changes.sourceJa: 確認しました。三人目のお席は到着予定が決まってからのご案内になります。別会計はできません。席料はお一人三百円で、お料理と飲み物は別にメニューの価格で計算します。

changes.before: 明白了。這就帶二位到座位。聯絡好同行者後，請從選單選擇。謝謝您事先確認。

changes.before: जाँच लिया। तीसरे व्यक्ति की सीट उसका समय तय होने पर मिलेगी। अलग बिल नहीं हो सकते। प्रति व्यक्ति सीट शुल्क तीन सौ येन है; भोजन और पेय की मेन्यू कीमत अलग लगेगी।
changes.after: जाँच लिया है। तीसरे व्यक्ति के आने का अनुमानित समय तय होने के बाद उसकी सीट के बारे में बताएँगे। अलग-अलग बिल नहीं बन सकते। प्रति व्यक्ति सीट शुल्क तीन सौ येन है; भोजन और पेय की कीमत मेन्यू के अनुसार अलग से जोड़ी जाएगी।

scenarioNotes.rationale: Read all 11 Japanese turns and 5 hints and every target in 12 locales. Preserved tentative photo-location inference, shared live location, prohibition on crossing temporary fence, waiting outside fence and no movement before reply. Repaired Tagalog request direction, Chinese literal wandering wording, and Hindi map/photo grammar.
sourceIssues: Japanese turn07 通路の外 is spatially vague; preserved without inventing a meeting point.

scenarioNotes.rationale: Compared all sentence and hint targets against complete Clock Tower visit exchange: exterior-only plan changes to historical interest, short Japanese versus historical terminology, overview materials, conditional photography permission, term-only notes with exhibit heading and no touching. Corrected reception question and Bengali/Hindi permission-check phrasing; no permission or historical fact invented.

Full 12-locale sentence/task comparison for observation-area/acrophobia exchange. Kept window proximity versus elevator distinction, conditional waiting-area availability and going together only if comfortable waiting is confirmed, return route, alerting staff before moving if unwell, and alternative independent visit with reunion. Removed unasserted seat from Vietnamese waiting-area wording and restored comparative rather than absolute no-elevator-fear in Indonesian/Chinese hints.

All 192 target fields read in medical reception scenario. Preserved right wrist, new fingertip numbness this morning and comparison with yesterday, escalation to medical staff without reception diagnosis, absent appointment/referral, no guarantee of acceptance, both ID cards and fall-time note. Fixed Bengali fall/read ambiguity, Hindi temporal comparison, Indonesian residence-card specificity and Thai no-guarantee sentence. Translation review only, no clinical acceptance claim.

Read complete found-wallet Japanese exchange and all target sentences/hints. Confirmed twenty-minute/crosswalk location, no removal or card photography, finder rather than owner rights, permission to decide after learning contact disclosure, reward choice and no direct owner contact. Corrected Thai map-showing request direction, Bengali finder-rights referent and Khmer unchanged-condition wording; no legal rights or sharing guarantee added.

Full 12-locale read found sentence/task meaning preserved: factory work begins tomorrow, employer specifies toe cap and slip-resistant soles rather than ordinary black sports shoes, selling the type does not guarantee 26 cm stock, contact details are conditional on directory listing, fallback is employer-designated shop, and purchase withheld unless requirements verified. No translation changes necessary; retail availability remains a question rather than a factual promise.

Compared all12 sentence/task sets for vegetable shelf-price mismatch. Preserved 100 g unit price versus 300 g bag, neighboring product origin distinction, checking barcode and weight before checkout, two bags only tentative and final quantity deferred until full-bag price confirmed. Repaired Tagalog net-weight wording and Hindi displayed-price/confusion grammar; no invented price or arithmetic answer.

Full all12 contextual review of ramen seating/luggage exchange. Preserved adjacent seating preference for menu-reading help, suitcase cannot obstruct aisle, order after seating and storage settled, per-dish spicy adjustment inquiry with no promise, and waiting without blocking entrance. Replaced Traditional Chinese software-menu term 選單 with restaurant 菜單 in every affected sentence/hint; clarified Thai request to show luggage size.

Full all12 field review of uncertain third diner and billing. All numeric bindings checked: 300 yen/person, two diners 600 yen, food/drink added separately; no separate bills. Decision changes from tentative three to two only and colleague meets elsewhere after meal. Kept seat allocation conditional on arrival timing, clarified Hindi as guidance rather than guaranteed seat and Traditional Chinese restaurant-menu term.

Full all12 sentence/hint review for cooler-box return. Checked box/lid/borrowed strap, missing strap at home, return deadline day after tomorrow versus agreed return tomorrow, no substitute strap, matching numbers and pre-existing scratch. Deposit handling must follow slip conditions after return inspection; corrected Thai refund-guarantee drift back to settlement, Khmer request direction and Indonesian redundant settlement wording.
sourceIssues: Japanese turn08 says scratch present since yesterday while hint specifies since borrowing; retained historical source/hint difference without asserting damage responsibility.
